title: Full-bandwidth transformer
abstract: arXiv:2608.08888v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autoregressive transformers compute along two axes: horizontally across generated tokens, and vertically through model depth. Dense attention gives each token broad horizontal access to the past, but the vertical feedback channel between decoding steps remains narrow: only the sampled token returns to the bottom of the stack, while the top-layer hidden state is discarded. We introduce the full-bandwidth transformer, which widens this channel with latent feedback: at each decoding step, the previous top-layer hidden state is fused with the sampled token embedding through a gated linear unit and fed back as the next input. Latent feedback lets non-verbalized computation re-enter the stack with a renewed depth budget, while preserving the standard transformer architecture, KV cache, and language-modeling objective. translated_abstract: 自回归Transformer沿两个轴进行计算：横向跨越生成的token，纵向贯穿模型深度。密集注意力使每个token能够广泛地横向访问过去的信息，但解码步骤之间的纵向反馈通道仍然狭窄：只有采样得到的token会返回到堆栈底部，而顶层隐藏状态则被丢弃。我们提出了全带宽Transformer，它通过潜在反馈来拓宽这一通道：在每个解码步骤中，将上一步的顶层隐藏状态通过门控线性单元与采样token的嵌入融合，并作为下一步的输入反馈回去。潜在反馈使得未被言语化的计算能够以新的深度预算重新进入堆栈，同时保持标准的Transformer架构、KV缓存和语言建模目标不变。为了在不损失并行教师强制的情况下训练全带宽Transformer，我们使用了调度的多遍目标……
tldr: 该论文提出全带宽Transformer，通过门控线性单元将上一步的顶层隐藏状态与采样token嵌入融合并反馈为下一步输入，拓宽了解码步骤间的纵向反馈通道，同时完整保留了标准Transformer架构、KV缓存和语言建模目标。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the full-bandwidth transformer, which widens the vertical feedback channel between decoding steps by fusing the previous top-layer hidden state with the sampled token embedding via a gated linear unit, while preserving the standard transformer architecture, KV cache, and language-modeling objective.
